mapper.select:
select distinct code, name from warehouse_location
is_deleted = false and type = 'location'
and code ilike concat('%', #{params.code}::text ,'%')
order by code asc NULLS FIRST

select wl.id, wl.type, wl.code, wl.name, wl.status, wl.warehouse_id, wl.parent_id, wl.disabled, wl.remark, wl.occupy_status from warehouse_location wl where wl.is_deleted = false
and
(wl.warehouse_id = #{item.warehouseId} and wl.code = #{item.code})
select id, code, name, area_type from warehouse_location where warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and type = 'area' and is_deleted = false and disabled = false

select id,code,name,status,disabled,usableQty from ( select wl.id, wl.code, wl.name, wl.status, wl.disabled, COALESCE ( i.qty, 0 ) as usableQty from warehouse_location wl left join inventory i on wl.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id and wl.code = i.warehouse_location AND sku_no = #{params.skuNo} AND wl.code = i.warehouse_location AND i.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' AND i.is_deleted = FALSE where wl.is_deleted = false and wl.type = 'location'
AND i.qty > 0
and wl.warehouse_id = #{params.warehouseId}
and ((wl.code = #{params.searchKeyword}) or wl.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
and wl.parent_id = #{params.warehouseAreaId}
order by usableQty desc,
case when wl.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when wl.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when wl.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , wl.name,
wl.code ) ws

select count(1) from warehouse_location wl inner join warehouse_location wa on wl.parent_id = wa.id inner join warehouse wt on wl.warehouse_id = wt.id where wl.is_deleted = false and wa.is_deleted = false and wt.is_deleted = false and wt.approve_status = 'approve'
and wl.status = #{statusCode};

select wl.* from warehouse_location wl left join warehouse_location wa on wl.parent_id = wa.id and wl.is_deleted = false and wa.is_deleted = false and wl.disabled = false and wa.disabled = false where wa.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and wa.code = #{warehouseArea}

select wa.warehouse_id as warehouseId, wa.id as areaId, wa.code as areaCode, wa.name as areaName, wa.area_type as areaType, wl.id as locationId, wl.code as locationCode, wl.name as locationName from warehouse_location wa left join warehouse_location wl on wl.parent_id = wa.id where wa.type = 'area' and wa.is_deleted = false and wl.is_deleted = false and wa.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
